messages:
eve_support: Heads-up: three separate support tickets asking for incremental structured frames over chat streaming when a tool/function is invoked. Customers want parseable JSON chunks as they arrive so downstream systems can begin work before the full tool completes.

matt_p: Who are the customers and how urgent? need to prioritize backlog.

eve_support: BrightHire (on paid support), NimbusHealth (enterprise trial), and AcmeBots (private deployment). BrightHire flagged it as blocking an integration demo.

jules_eng: Current streaming model emits token deltas. To support parseable JSON frames we need a framing envelope (event-based) or guarantee that emitted tokens form valid JSON chunks. Framing is safer.

alex_sales: Commercial note: BrightHire will convert to committed usage if we deliver a pilot. AcmeBots wants private resume semantics but that's lower priority than basic frames.

matt_p: Proposed scope options:
- Lite: delimiting boundaries with a small metadata event when tool starts/ends. Fast but requires consumers to do more glue.
- Core: event envelope with types (tool_start, tool_frame, tool_end, data) and a `seq` field for reassembly. Matches customer asks.
- Complete: Core + resumable streams with offsets and replay API for Private. Higher infra cost.

eve_support: Customers explicitly asked for the Core option: parseable frames and a seq index. Resume is nice-to-have but not required for pilot.

jules_eng: Medium/Core path looks feasible. Notes:
- Use existing streaming endpoints but introduce an envelope JSON per event.
- Emit `tool_frame` events with `seq` and payload (<=32KB suggested).
- Runtime needs lightweight per-stream state and backpressure propagation to tool layer.
- Private: control plane compatibility/migration will need a short plan.

jules_eng: Rough timeline: 1-week spike to validate framing perf, then 2 sprints for a pilot-grade impl. Additional 2 sprints for resume/replay support for Private.

matt_p: Pilot acceptance criteria draft:
- Published API envelope spec + examples
- SDK examples (Node, Python) showing frame reassembly
- First-frame latency under 200ms for typical tool calls
- Seq-based gap detection works end-to-end
- No partial-sensitive data logged

sam_prod_ops: deploy-bot: rolling update required for runtime and gateway. Schedule maintenance windows for Dedicated/Private customers.

alex_sales: I'll secure NDA language for telemetry with pilot customers and confirm BrightHire will join.

eve_support: I'll create a consolidated intake doc linking all tickets and ask customers for their exact schema needs. Also scheduling a short design call.

matt_p: I'll draft a concise PRD with the three scope options and the pilot acceptance criteria. If BrightHire + Acme opt-in, target a 6-week pilot for Core scope.

jules_eng: I'll run the 1-week spike and post perf numbers here.

eve_support: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
